case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your counter-proposals; we are certainly open to a 24-month contract to ensure stability for both sides. However, your suggested prices do not reflect the reality of our production costs, especially the recent wage increases.

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we can offer a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This complete proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Our foundry takes great pride in the reliable quality and craftsmanship we deliver to Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. It is always a pleasure working alongside such a valued regional partner, and we trust this adjusted Angebot will serve as a sound basis for our continued shared future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised proposals; we appreciate the movement you have shown. As a family-run foundry with deep roots in our region, we value our long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and always aim to find a common path forward.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. However, we are still some distance apart, as our production costs remain a firm reality. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

To keep our discussions constructive, we can reduce our price to a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

We trust this offer shows our commitment to working together and keeping our longstanding partnership strong.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement and are willing to accommodate your request to delay the effective date to 1 April 2027. In exchange for this later start date, we can offer a price of €50.40 per unit. We believe this is a fair compromise that supports our long-standing partnership while reflecting our firm production costs.

Our complete offer stands at a price of €50.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure to work together with your esteemed company, and our family foundry remains committed to supplying you with the highest quality craftsmanship.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
